AI Assistant (MCP)

Use the AI assistant to query project data and perform actions through natural language.

MCP Gateway

MCP (Model Context Protocol) SSE router for conversational AI integration.

This module mounts the MCP server’s SSE (Server-Sent Events) transport into the FastAPI application, allowing local desktop or browser-based AI copilot flyouts to connect and invoke the exposed tool functions.

Endpoints

  • GET /sse — Establishes an SSE connection. The server sends the message endpoint URL as the first event, then keeps the connection open for real-time tool response streaming.

  • POST /messages — Receives MCP protocol messages (tool calls, results, etc.) from the connected client and routes them to the appropriate MCP tool handler.

Security

All tool invocations must include a valid auth_token parameter containing the user’s JWT Bearer token. The MCP service layer validates this token on every tool call and enforces ABAC clearance filtering before returning any data.

Connection Flow

  1. Client opens an SSE connection to /api/v1/mcp/sse.

  2. Server responds with the message endpoint URL (e.g., /api/v1/mcp/messages/?session_id=...).

  3. Client sends MCP protocol JSON-RPC messages via POST to the message endpoint.

  4. Server processes tool calls and streams results back over the SSE connection.

Why SSE?

SSE (Server-Sent Events) is the recommended transport for integrating MCP servers into web applications. Unlike STDIO transport (which requires local process spawning), SSE works over standard HTTP and can be used from browser-based copilot interfaces.

The SSE connection is unidirectional (server-to-client for events), while client-to-server communication uses standard HTTP POST requests to the message endpoint.
